create.name: Ananda Sangha Mumbai
create.bio:
Ananda Sangha Mumbai is the city's centre for the Kriya Yoga teachings of Paramhansa Yogananda, belonging to the worldwide Ananda family that Swami Kriyananda, a disciple of Yogananda, began in the late 1960s. Its meditation centre is on the second floor of the Bengal Chemicals building on S.V. Savarkar Marg in Prabhadevi, opposite the Worli fire station, and visitors are welcome to drop in during opening hours.

The centre keeps a steady rhythm of practice: silent meditations on weekday mornings and evenings and on Saturday mornings, a guided meditation on Friday evenings, and a Sunday-morning satsang that can also be joined online. Newcomers start with Learn to Meditate, a two-hour session on posture, the breath-mind link, the Hong-Sau technique and building a routine, which opens the way to the six-session course on the art and science of raja yoga, covering yama and niyama, Yogananda's Energization Exercises, yogic breathing and Patanjali's eight limbs.

Ananda Yoga sessions teach gentle, inward-looking postures paired with silent affirmations. The calendar also includes kirtans, purification ceremonies, workshops, book study, children's activities and pilgrimages.

courses.title: Learn to Meditate: The Path of Kriya Yoga (Level 1)
courses.description: A two-hour in-person session at the Prabhadevi centre on Sunday 6 December 2026 (11:30 am–1:30 pm) covering correct posture, quieting the restless mind, the breath-mind connection, the Hong-Sau technique and setting up a daily routine, with a guided meditation and course book.

courses.title: The Art and Science of Raja Yoga (Level 2)
courses.description: A six-session in-person course for those who have completed Level 1: energy, will and magnetism, Sankhya and Vedanta, yama and niyama, the 39 Energization Exercises, yogic breathing, habits and affirmations, and Patanjali's ashtanga yoga, with Ananda Yoga postures. Pre-enrolment open.
courses.price: Rs. 3,500 (includes the book Art and Science of Raja Yoga)

courses.title: Ananda Yoga
courses.description: Gentle, inwardly directed hatha yoga in Kriyananda's style, combining Yogananda's Energization Exercises with postures each paired with a silent affirmation, pranayama and meditation. Suitable for beginners; contact the centre for session dates.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation (Fridays) and Sunday Satsang
free_resources.description: Weekly practice at the Prabhadevi centre: a guided meditation every Friday 6–7 pm and a Sunday satsang 10–11 am, both in person and on Zoom, alongside silent meditations on other mornings and evenings.
